verdict.rationale: Runloop's docs explicitly cover a dedicated 'Give your AI agent access to modify and interact with files on your devbox' file operations feature, and Cursor rule files mention SDK 'file operations' as a core covered capability alongside SDKs in common languages to interact with the API. This strongly implies read/write/upload/download file support via the SDK, though the evidence lacks explicit upload/download method names or code snippets. Missing for 10: explicit SDK code examples showing read/write/upload/download calls and independent hands-on confirmation.
